messages:
sara: quick FYI — canary traffic shows p95 up ~1.8x after today's merge, affecting decode-heavy routes. noticed around 2170001100. @liam can you triage?
liam: saw perf-bot alert too. p95 jump starts at ~step 120 in canary traces. not consistent across seq len yet.
perf-bot: CI perf test 'decode_p95_long' failed on merge: +87% p95, bench id: bench/2026-03-16-08. Full diff: https://perf.redwood/bench/2026-03-16-08
jordan: any quick revert candidate? what changed in kernel selector or batching last merge?
ash: the merge touched kernel-selection heuristics and added warmup heuristics for attention kernels (PR 5423). suspect selector now prefers attention-fallback path for some token shapes.
liam: I grabbed perf profile (hotspots). top cost: attention fallback kernel + memory copy on KV path during decode. KV hit rate also dropped in canary.
sara: KV hit rate dropped? that's new — could be cache key normalization change?
liam: paste of `perf top` snip:
```
50.1% attention_fallback_kernel
18.3% kv_memcopy
9.2% decode_dispatch
```
ash: added a small change to prefix hashing around PR 5417 that accidentally changed cache keys when prompt had trailing whitespace. that could explain KV misses.
jordan: can we reproduce locally with the canary model + sample workload? i can run a targeted A/B with and without PR 5417.
liam: repro script:
```
python infra/tests/repro_decode_perf.py --model canary_v3 --prompt-file tests/long_prompts.txt --iters 200
```
sara: @ash if that's the cause we should either hotfix key normalization or revert the heuristics depending on risk. current canary is on hold.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment 2026-03-16T12:30 triggered hold due to perf delta. Action: rollback disabled until triage complete.
ash: I'm running a git-bisect focusing on PRs touching `kv_cache` and `kernel_selector`. quick note: PR 5417 and 5423 are correlated.
liam: results from bisect prelim: bad commit = 0b3f2c4 (PR 5417) — changes prefix hashing + header trimming for cache keys.
jordan: nice bisect. can we patch 0b3f2c4 to keep new heuristics but restore old key formatting? small patch prepared.
ash: patch applied locally, reran repro, p95 back to baseline.
sara: decision: patch the key normalization ASAP, keep kernel selector heuristics since they don't strictly regress when cache hits are fixed. create hotfix PR and gate CANARY after patch lands.
liam: opened PR 5430 (hotfix: normalize-kv-keys) -> link: https://git.redwood/PR/5430
perf-bot: Regression alert resolved in bench 2026-03-16-09 after PR 5430 landed: decode_p95_long delta: -2%
jordan: follow ups: add unit tests for kv key canonicalization, add e2e perf smoke in CI for decode_p95_long, and add a dashboard panel for kv-hit-rate by prompt shape.
sara: thanks all. reminder to document selector assumptions in kernel_selector/README so future heuristics changes include cache-key impact note. :thumbsup:
